products.name: HP DesignJet T250 24" Compact Large Format Plotter Printer
products.description:
HP DesignJet T250 24" Compact Large Format Plotter Printer

The HP DesignJet T250 is perfect for AEC, GIS, and MCAD professionals who want to print maps, technical drawings, posters, and renders with precise, accurate line quality and crisp text Print easily and affordably with the world's smallest wide-format printer. The T250 has been designed to fit your office, budget, and the way you work, the world's smallest plotters provide outstanding simplicity. You can send multiple files in just one click and print your A1/D plot as fast as 30 seconds. 500 MB memory. Impressive simplicity helps you save time and reduces waste. Use up to 95% less ink for routine maintenance. More sustainable design reduces CO2e up to 7.3 tons/year by units sold by using up to 30% recycled plastic. With an accessory option, print multi-size A3/B and A1/D projects without manually switching the media source. This printer is intended to work only with cartridges that have a new or reused HP chip, and it uses dynamic security measures to block cartridges using a non-HP chip. Periodic firmware updates will maintain the effectiveness of these measures and block cartridges that previously worked. A reused HP chip enables the use of reused, remanufactured, and refilled cartridges. The HP DesignJet T250 comes with a 1-year warranty.

products.name: HP DesignJet Z6 44" PostScript Printer
products.description:
HP DesignJet Z6 44" PostScript Printer

The HP DesignJet Z6 44" PostScript Printer is a professional and multifunctional printer capable of producing high-quality prints for a wide range of applications. It is a print-only device that delivers brilliant colors and crisp details by utilizing HP Thermal Inkjet technology and six pigment-based ink cartridges. It offers an optimum resolution of up to 2400 x 1200 dpi and a print speed of up to 866 ft2/hr on plain media. It supports the print languages Adobe PostScript 3, Adobe PDF 1.7, TIFF, JPEG, CALS G4, HP-GL/2, and HP-RTL, allowing you to print complicated and huge files with ease. It supports A4, A3, A2, A1, A0 media typed. The HP DesignJet Z6 44" PostScript Printer offers a modern and ergonomic design that is ideal for usage in the office. It has a roll feed, a rear sheet feed, a media output bin, and an automatic horizontal cutter that can handle photographic, fine art, self-adhesive, banner and sign, bond and coated, and backlit media. It contains an LED display that indicates the printer status as well as the printer settings. It also includes a Gigabit Ethernet port and a Hi-Speed USB 2.0 port for connecting the printer to your network or computer. You may also print from your mobile device using the HP ePrint and HP Smart apps. The HP DesignJet Z6 44" PostScript Printer is an intelligent and dependable printer that can boost your productivity and creativity. It contains 128 GB of virtual memory and a 500 GB self-encrypting hard disk that can store and execute massive files efficiently. It also has less than 1 dE2000 color stability in less than 5 minutes and print repeatability of less than 0.5 dE2000, ensuring consistent and accurate colors across prints.
